"];
const toffifeeStandFrames=TOFFIFEE_STAND_ASSETS.map(src=>{const im=new Image();im.src=src;return im});
const TOFFIFEE_STAND_SOURCE_WIDTH=220;
function standStageForAssembly(progress){return Math.min(5,Math.max(0,Math.floor(clamp(progress,0,1)*6)))}
function standStageForDismantling(progress){return 5-Math.min(5,Math.max(0,Math.floor(clamp(progress,0,1)*6)))}
function drawToffifeeStand(x,y,stage=5,alpha=1){
const image=toffifeeStandFrames[clamp(stage|0,0,5)];
if(!image||!image.complete||!image.naturalWidth){
ctx.fillStyle='#d57627';ctx.fillRect(x*TILE+2,y*TILE+3,TILE-4,TILE-6);
return;
}
// A shared source scale, NOT six independently fitted images (prevents wobble).
const scale=30/TOFFIFEE_STAND_SOURCE_WIDTH;
const w=image.naturalWidth*scale,h=image.naturalHeight*scale;
const px=(x+.5)*TILE-w/2;
const py=(y+1)*TILE-h-1;
ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha*=alpha;ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
ctx.fillStyle='#00000025';ctx.beginPath();
ctx.ellipse((x+.5)*TILE,(y+1)*TILE-3,13,3,0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
ctx.drawImage(image,px,py,w,h);
ctx.restore();
}
